sourceAuthority.citation: Johnson, J. A. (2014). Journal of Research in Personality 51, 78-89.

prompt.en: Am often down in the dumps.
Find it difficult to approach others.
prompt.zh-Hans: 觉得主动接近别人很困难。

prompt.en: Am afraid to draw attention to myself.

prompt.zh-Hans: 只有和熟悉的朋友在一起才自在。

prompt.en: Am not bothered by difficult social situations.
prompt.zh-Hans: 面对棘手的社交情境也不太困扰。

prompt.en: Am able to control my cravings.
prompt.zh-Hans: 能控制自己的强烈欲望。
容易被事件压得喘不过气。

prompt.en: Feel that I'm unable to deal with things.
prompt.zh-Hans: 常觉得自己应付不了事情。
在压力下仍能保持冷静。

prompt.en: Talk to a lot of different people at parties.
prompt.zh-Hans: 在聚会中会和很多不同的人交谈。
会把事情掌握在自己手中。

prompt.en: Wait for others to lead the way.
Do a lot in my spare time.
prompt.zh-Hans: 空闲时间也会做很多事。
有时会做出疯狂大胆的举动。

prompt.en: Look at the bright side of life.
prompt.zh-Hans: 倾向看到生活积极的一面。

prompt.en: Like to get lost in thought.
Believe in the importance of art.
See beauty in things that others might not notice.
prompt.zh-Hans: 能注意到别人可能忽略的美。

prompt.en: Do not enjoy going to art museums.

prompt.zh-Hans: 强烈地体验自己的情绪。
很少注意到自己的情绪反应。

prompt.en: Don't understand people who get emotional.
prompt.zh-Hans: 不太理解情绪强烈的人。
比起固定惯例更喜欢变化。

prompt.en: Prefer to stick with things that I know.
prompt.zh-Hans: 更喜欢坚持熟悉的事物。
喜欢阅读有挑战性的材料。

prompt.en: Am not interested in theoretical discussions.
Tend to vote for liberal political candidates.
prompt.zh-Hans: 倾向投票给较自由派的政治候选人。

prompt.en: Believe that there is no absolute right and wrong.
prompt.zh-Hans: 认为对错并非总是绝对。

prompt.en: Tend to vote for conservative political candidates.
prompt.zh-Hans: 倾向投票给较保守派的政治候选人。

prompt.en: Believe that we should be tough on crime.
prompt.zh-Hans: 认为对犯罪应采取严厉态度。

prompt.en: Believe that others have good intentions.
prompt.zh-Hans: 相信别人通常怀有善意。

prompt.en: Use others for my own ends.
prompt.zh-Hans: 为达到自己的目的而利用别人。

prompt.en: Am indifferent to the feelings of others.
prompt.zh-Hans: 对别人的感受漠不关心。

prompt.en: Believe that I am better than others.
prompt.zh-Hans: 认为自己比别人更优秀。

prompt.en: Have a high opinion of myself.
Feel sympathy for those who are worse off than myself.
prompt.zh-Hans: 同情处境比自己困难的人。

prompt.en: Am not interested in other people's problems.
prompt.zh-Hans: 对别人的问题不感兴趣。

prompt.en: Try not to think about the needy.
prompt.zh-Hans: 尽量不去想需要帮助的人。
在所做的事情上表现出色。

prompt.en: Know how to get things done.
Often forget to put things back in their proper place.
Leave a mess in my room.
Do more than what's expected of me.
prompt.zh-Hans: 做得比别人对我的期待更多。

prompt.en: Put little time and effort into my work.
prompt.zh-Hans: 很少在工作上投入时间和精力。

prompt.en: Do just enough work to get by.
prompt.zh-Hans: 只做刚好足以过关的工作。

scoring.domainScore: sum six facet scores; raw range 24..120
